manifest.sql:
SELECT a.id AS album_id, a.event AS album_event, a.sgf_content,
       a.source_path, r.id AS raw_event_id, r.parsed_data->>'series_core' AS series_core
FROM kifu_albums a JOIN kifu_raw_event_values r ON r.raw_value = a.event
WHERE a.event_id IS NULL AND r.category = 'unclassified_pending' AND a.id > :after_id
ORDER BY a.id LIMIT :limit

Go-Seigen played mane (imitation) go up to move 64.

Iwamoto maintained that he did not have to fill the final ko because
he had more ko threats than White. Unaware of any official rules,
the referee (Segoe) was unable to resolve the matter. As Go had won anyway,
the result was published as "White won by 1 or 2". A few days later someone
discovered that a committee set up in Shusai's time had drawn up a byelaw
that agreed with Iwamoto's interpretation, so the official result became W+1.
The first Nihon Ki-in rules issued in the following year said players had to
eliminate possible kos at the end of the game.

interpretation: Exact string/component differences are research conflicts, not identity contradictions. GN/GC originate from same stored SGF and do not establish independent evidence or safe dedup.
recovery: Stream output contains one manifest, ordered album/parse_error records, then complete summary. Missing summary means incomplete capture; local summarizer refuses a complete report. Resume into a new segment with --after-id last complete album ID and record a NEW snapshot; segments cannot claim one transaction snapshot if production changed. Never reuse the same output path for a resumed segment.
recommendations: Prioritize supplemental named Chinese context for historical national team/individual/grade competitions and Korean league records; research exact year/round from professional sources before type approval.
Use full candidate text, root field provenance and exact album IDs; later GN and GC agreement is only one-source repetition.
Flag strings such as Black wins the ko, multiline comments and unusually long GC labels as review text; never blindly create an event.
Keep raw series_core differences separate from canonical event identity. Current component parser leaves many rounds embedded; grouping alone does not establish identity or dedup.
Run local offline candidate grouping from pinned capture before further DB reads; freeze per-game proposal artifacts for review.
